Prim. Reason: DEEPEN DIR (Directional Deepening)
Description: Drilling of well VHRJ-028, Start OPR: 10/27/2023 12:00:00AM
Current Ops: PULLING OUT DIRECTIONAL BHA OF 12 1/4" WITH PDC BIT, MUD MOTOR AND MWD, WITH 5 1/2" DP IN ELEVATORS @ 5,200 ft MD

24-Hr Summary: CONTINUED DRILLING 12 1/4" SECTION WITH PDC BIT, MUD MOTOR AND MWD TO CASING POINT OF 9 5/8" @ 6,315 ft MD + CIRCULATED HOLE + SHORT TRIP FOR CONTROL TO TOP OF ORTEGUAZA (5200 ft MD) + RETURNED TO BOTTOM + CIRCULATED HOLE + PULLED OUT BHA#2

OTHER REMARKS - Solids Control: Worked with selective flocculation and Dewatering to system with 2 Centrifuges for a total of 20 hrs. LGS performed in a total of 4hrs with 2 Decanter Centrifuges.
